g.text: Module temperature on the computational mesh: 960 finite-volume cells, each drawn at its own extent and coloured by its own stored value.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: One colour scale is shared by all six frames and spans the full range of the data shown -- nothing is clipped.
